name: Sparkling Water
siboNotes: Plain sparkling water is SIBO-friendly, though some people may experience increased bloating from carbonation during active symptoms.
preparationTips: Choose plain sparkling water without added flavors or sweeteners
Check labels to avoid artificial sweeteners like sorbitol or mannitol
Let it sit open briefly to reduce carbonation if gas causes discomfort
Serve chilled for best taste experience
nutritionalHighlights: May contain trace minerals depending on source
Can help meet daily fluid intake goals
